 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Our Miami Dolphins will face a team today that has struggled similarly this season. The Indianapolis Colts come into Week 10 with one more win (2-7) than our Phins and are coming off a five-game losing streak, including their loss last Sunday to the Dallas Cowboys, 23-27. The Dolphins have dropped their last two games, including last weekend, when they gave the Detroit Lions more fight than most expected, before ultimately losing 9-19.
 Please use this live thread to discuss this afternoon's game vs. the Colts, the latest NFL news from the past week, and all things Miami Dolphins. As a reminder, please follow our standard site rules, and please note that sharing or requesting illegal game streams is strictly prohibited and may result in a suspension from The Phinsider or the wider SBN platform. Enjoy the game!
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Miami Dolphins (1-7) 4th AFC East @ Indianapolis Colts (2-7) 3rd AFC South
 When: Sunday, November 15th, 1:00 PM EST

 FanDuel sportsbook betting odds: Spread: Colts -4.5; Point total: 37.5; Moneyline: Colts -210 | Dolphins +176
 Referees: Carl Cheffers Don Willard(Referee); Derek Anderson (Umpire); Derick Bowers (Down Judge); Quentin Givens (Line Judge); Jabir Walker (Field Judge); Dominique Pender (Side Judge); Martin Hankins (Back Judge); Martin Abezetian (Replay Official); Brian Davies (Replay Assistant) ( Note: Due to the FAA nationwide ground halt on Friday, the NFL has activated their referee contingency plans, which will have backup officials filling in at games near their hometown rather than trying to force air travel this weekend. That will include side judge Don Willard from Scott Novak's team sliding into the Dolphins-Colts game as the referee, then refereeing the Steelers-Bengals Sunday Night Football game later today. Other changes to the crew may have been activated but not announced. )
